name: Hammock
description: A blissfully laid-back man in his mid thirties who practically lives in the backyard hammock, and sings mellow jam-band rock.
build: A lean, loose adult build: relaxed sloping shoulders, a slim chest, long arms and legs of ordinary proportion, standing upright with soft relaxed knees.
face: Tanned golden skin, sleepy brown eyes under straight brown brows, a long nose, a full untrimmed brown beard, and a wide mouth.
hair: Long wavy brown hair to the shoulders, full and loose, tucked behind both ears.
outfit: A faded oversized mustard tee with short sleeves and a big faded orange sun circle on the chest; a chunky necklace of large wooden beads; loose olive-green drawstring cargo shorts to the knee; brown leather flip-flops. Both arms and hands are bare.
performance_style: Totally at ease: feet apart, weight sunk into one hip, shoulders loose. Both arms hang long and relaxed, the character-right and character-left hands open and empty, fingers loose and visible. Head tilted, a lazy half-lidded smile.
location: A shady backyard corner: green lawn running to the bottom of the frame, a striped rope hammock slung between two big oak trees, a cooler and a tiki torch nearby, and warm evening sun through the leaves with string lights above.
recognition_cues: long wavy brown hair and a full beard
a faded mustard tee with a big orange sun

sing.intent: Jam-band vocal loop: a slow noodling sway, eyes half closed, the mic in the character-right hand at the mouth, the character-left hand floating up in a lazy wave, then return to the easy stance. The mouth visibly opens and changes shape across the loop so the character unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: A slow-motion startle at a slammed cooler lid: brows rise, both open hands lift a little, then he sinks back into the easy stance. No opponent or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot: raise both open hands palm-out at chest height in a peaceful 'easy, man', then hold. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot: amble in, stop square to the front, stretch both arms and settle into the easy stance.
